parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale addresses all four error targets. It corrects the evidence misread about the ECG suggestion by noting it doesn't identify a specific figure/table. It removes the unsupported inference that authors can easily identify the referenced part. It corrects the evidence misread about RTLP/MARGE by noting naming models alone doesn't ground the comment to a specific section. It fixes the rubric misapplication and score mapping error by recognizing weak rather than full grounding while preserving the observation that specificity is met. The rationale preserves the valid observation that both comments do specify what needs to be addressed. It does not state a numeric final score or gold label. The change log coherently documents each correction. The corrected rationale is complete and coherent.
